strongest_bounded_proposition: Korean historical synthesis identifies nobi as the lowest status group in Goguryeo, with war captivity, punishment/family liability and debt among pathways into the status.
strongest_unsupported_proposition: Do not assume later Goryeo/Joseon nobi law, prevalence or property rules applied unchanged to Goguryeo c.500.
territorial_practice_summary: A recognized unfree/nobi status is supported in Goguryeo.
legal_state_summary: Historical records cited in the Korean national history synthesis describe criminal/family enslavement and debt-related pathways.
external_network_summary: War captivity is one documented source of nobi.
terminology_category_qualification: Nobi is historically specific; later debates over Korean slavery cannot be projected unchanged backward.
temporal_scope_precision: The synthesis concerns Goguryeo's Three Kingdoms social structure and is directly relevant to the 500 CE target.
language_access_limitations: English-accessible research packet only; non-English and non-digitized scholarship was not exhaustively searched.
